newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo slips vs mark, dealers eye Bank/Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Escudo slips vs mark, dealers eye Bank/Portugal.

text.p: The escudo slipped against the mark in early trade, touching a low of 101.10 before steadying to 101.05/08. Traders did not rule out a further easing of the currency during Tuesday.
But traders said that if the escudo fell much further, the Bank of Portugal could intervene to block its decline. The currency had closed at 100.94/97 on Monday.
They said that the market was adjusting to sales of escudo against the mark carried out by one large foreign player.
"101.15 is a good level of support and anyway at that level there is the risk of intervention by the Bank," said one trader.
